---
title: "Rote Song by Ear"
description: "Learn a song by ear through the MLT Rote Song Procedure, one step at a time: tonality, the whole song, macrobeats and microbeats, the resting tone, audiating, then singing it alone. No notation."
toc: false
---

{{< include _scripts.qmd >}}

Choose a song, then go through the steps in order with **Next →**, or jump to any step in the list. The notation is
never shown: the song is learned by listening, moving and audiating. The steps follow Mullen's Rote Song Procedure;
step 8, **Audiate the ending**, is this site's addition: the song stops suddenly somewhere in its last quarter, and you
keep it going in your head and press **Space** (or **Tap**) exactly when its last note would sound.

The songs here are the ones the MLT book units name. Each unit's song list also has a 👂 **by ear** button for
every song.

```{=html}
<div class="rote-song"></div>
```
